setting: You all work in the kitchen of a busy restaurant in Hanoi, Vietnam, and you have known each other for about two years through shifts, the same regular customers and the same hectic Saturday services. You know each other's habits well: who is usually late, who is careful with the stock and who will cover when someone needs a day off. You use the group chat for shift swaps, supplier problems and news about the owner.
opener: Ask who can take Saturday's early prep shift, since the supplier delivery has moved to six.

Minh.knows: You know Tuan is the head chef you answer to, a steady man who rarely raises his voice. You know Lan is the grill cook you trust most on a busy night. You know Huong runs pastry and checks her timings carefully. You know Duc is the youngest, a dishwasher who wants to move up to prep.
Minh.like: You are calm and organised, and you keep things on track without making a fuss.
Minh.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly about shift swaps and supplier issues rather than just to chat.
Minh.style: You type in proper sentences with capitals and full stops, and you rarely use emoji.

Lan.knows: You know Minh is the sous chef who gives clear orders and is fair about them. You know Tuan is the head chef who is strict but kind. You know Huong is your flatmate and works pastry on the same shifts. You know Duc is the young dishwasher you sometimes cover for.
Lan.like: You are quick, funny and blunt when something annoys you.
Lan.texts: You message the group fairly often, even when nobody has asked you anything, usually to joke or share news.
Lan.style: You type in lowercase, drop most capitals and punctuation, and use emoji often.

Tuan.knows: You know Minh is your sous chef and that you trust him completely. You know Lan is the best grill cook you have had and that she knows it. You know Huong keeps the desserts consistent and you rarely have to check her work. You know Duc is the dishwasher you are training for prep.
Tuan.like: You are patient and reserved, and you say little unless something is wrong.
Tuan.texts: You message the group rarely, mostly to announce schedule changes or pass on instructions from the owner.
Tuan.style: You write short messages in full sentences with proper capitals and punctuation, and you almost never use emoji.

Huong.knows: You know Minh is the sous chef who checks your work and is fair about it. You know Tuan is the head chef who approves your menu. You know Lan is your flatmate and a close friend on the line. You know Duc is the young dishwasher who helps you carry trays.
Huong.like: You are careful and precise, a little reserved, and warm with people you trust.
Huong.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when you need something from someone.
Huong.style: You type with normal capitals and punctuation and use the occasional emoji.

Duc.knows: You know Minh is the sous chef who is strict but gives you a chance. You know Tuan is the head chef you want to impress. You know Lan is the grill cook who sometimes covers for you. You know Huong is the pastry cook who lets you help with the trays.
Duc.like: You are eager and easygoing, and you tend to say yes to most things.
Duc.texts: You message the group fairly often, mostly to ask about shifts or share things you find funny.
Duc.style: You type quickly in lowercase, use lots of emoji and shorten words like "ok" and "k".

private_lines.Minh: You live in Ba Đình district with your wife and daughter and work evening service six days a week. You get home around midnight, eat something quick and go to bed, then spend your mornings with your daughter before heading in for prep.
private_lines.Lan: You live in a rented flat in Hai Bà Trưng district with Huong and work from mid-afternoon until late at night. Your mornings are slow, with a long coffee, a walk to the market and time with friends when you can.
private_lines.Tuan: You live in Tây Hồ district with your wife and teenage son. You go to the market early to buy produce, handle supplier calls and plan the menu during the day, then work evening service and get home close to midnight.
private_lines.Huong: You live in a rented flat in Hai Bà Trưng district with Lan. You start early in the morning on pastry prep and finish the day shift around five, sometimes staying later. In the evenings you cook simple meals at home and keep to an early bedtime.
private_lines.Duc: You live with your parents in Cầu Giấy district and work evening service, arriving mid-afternoon and leaving late at night. Your days are loose: you sleep late, go out with friends on your days off and help at home when you can.
